messages:
sara: Quick heads-up — profiling across small-batch traffic shows per-token cost reported to billing is ~12% lower than actual runtime spend. KV-cache misses are being billed as if they were cheap; looks like we only attribute kernel time to the first token in a batch.

leo: Can you paste an example trace + query? Is this across all kernels or just fused-attn?

sara: Paste trace snippet: `trace-id: t-11a2` — we see `batch_size=1` paths and `kv_hit=false` taking ~45ms per token but token_accounting only records 5ms. Prom query I used: `sum(rate(runtime_token_latency_seconds_count[5m])) by (route,kernel_id,kv_hit)`

sophia: That matches my kernel selector profiling. When `kernel_selector` falls back to scalar path for short sequences we lose per-token attribution. Proposal: add `kernel_tag` + `kv_hit` labels to the per-token histogram and a `kernel_cpu_ns` counter for non-token overhead.

perf-bot: Alert: cost-per-token spike detected in prod-blue ~2026-01-17T14:12Z — delta +9.8% vs baseline. Top routes: /chat/stream, /embed/short

maria: Finance — how badly will this skew invoices for big customers? Any estimate?

kevin: Quick estimate: for customers with high small-window chat (~50M tokens/mo), this could underbill us by ~$2.3k/mo. We need aligned metrics to export to billing pipeline. Plan: (1) add `kv_hit` boolean label, (2) add `kernel_id` label, (3) instrument `token_overhead_seconds{category="kv_miss"}` for non-token work. We'll also sample full traces 1% to validate.

leo: Agree. We should be careful exploding series cardinality. Use `kernel_id` only for rollups — keep `kernel_family` for Grafana panels. Also cap label cardinality on route by normalizing route -> `route_group`.

sophia: Draft prometheus metric examples I will implement in runtime:

``
# per-token latency buckets
runtime_token_latency_seconds_bucket{route_group="chat",kernel_family="fused_attn",kv_hit="false",route="chat.short"} <value>

# non-token overhead counter (kv miss work)
runtime_token_overhead_seconds_total{route_group="chat",overhead="kv_miss",kernel_family="fused_attn"} 1234
``

I'll add sampling for traces: `trace.sample_rate=0.01`

kevin: I can wire metrics export to billing ETL. Two asks: expose the raw counters via metrics-bridge and add a nightly job to reconcile metrics -> billing tokens for last 30 days.

maria: Please include a short spec + estimate in the ticket. Need to know when finance can rely on the new numbers for invoices.

sara: I'll file the ticket and include perf traces, prom queries, and impact estimate. Tentative timeline: patch + canary in 2 weeks, dashboard in 3, billing reconciliation in 6.

leo: Action items: kevin (add metrics-bridge export), sophia (runtime patch & tests), sara (ticket + impact numbers), maria (provide max acceptable drift).

sophia: I'll also add a lightweight grafana dashboard with per-route token cost breakdown and kernel-family stacked series — share link when ready.

kevin: I'll add the export but will need a short-lived flag to avoid prod noise. Will coordinate with eng-sre for canary.

sara: Thanks. If anyone sees other routes with odd deltas, ping here. :thumbsup:
